def is_nested(string):
    stack = []
    for bracket in string:
        if bracket == '[':
            stack.append(bracket)
        elif bracket == ']':
            if not stack:
                return False  # Unmatched closing bracket
            stack.pop()
            if len(stack) > 1:  # Check for nesting
                return True
    
    return False

# Test cases
print(is_nested('[[]]'))       # ➞ True
print(is_nested('[]]]]]]][[[[[]'))   # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[][]'))      # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[]'))        # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[[][]]'))    # ➞ True
print(is_nested('[[]][['))    # ➞ True

CONFIDENCE: 95
